basic_details.job_title: MOIL SAP Functional Consultant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: MOIL Limited, a Schedule 'A' Miniratna category-I PSU under the Ministry of Steel, Government of India, has invited applications for six (06) SAP S/4HANA with RISE Functional Consultants on Fixed-Term Employment (FTE): one each in SAP HCM, SAP FICO, SAP MM, SAP PM, SAP SD and SAP PP, all under the UR category. Applications are sent by post, in the Annexure A form, to the General Manager (Mines) & Additional Charge HoD (Pers.), MOIL Ltd, MOIL Bhavan, 1-A, Katol Road, Nagpur-440 013, on or before 28 November 2026. The consolidated pay is ₹1,33,490 per month for each post.

application_fee.details: The fee is paid by Demand Draft drawn in favour of MOIL Limited, Nagpur, payable at Nagpur, and is sent with the application.

age_limit.details: The upper age limit of 40 years is for General category candidates. Age, qualification and experience are counted as on 28/11/2026. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC, physically challenged candidates (not less than 40% disability) and ex-servicemen is as per Government guidelines. The upper age limit is not applicable to Departmental candidates. Maximum age including all possible relaxation on 28/11/2026 shall not exceed 53 years in any case. SC, ST and OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates applying against a General (UR) post are considered on General category merit, with no relaxation in the upper age limit.

content_sections.heading: About MOIL
content_sections.text: MOIL Limited (formerly Manganese Ore (India) Limited) is a Government of India enterprise with its office at MOIL Bhavan, 1A, Katol Road, Nagpur. The notice describes it as the largest manganese ore producer in the country, operating ten mines in Maharashtra and Madhya Pradesh. The six consultants are being engaged for the company's SAP S/4HANA with RISE implementation.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications are to be sent in the application form given as Annexure A of the notice. Write 'Application for the post of ------' on the envelope. Address: General Manager (Mines) & Additional Charge HoD (Pers.), MOIL Ltd, MOIL Bhavan, 1-A, Katol Road, Nagpur-440 013. Fill in the Annexure A application form, with a recent passport-size photo in the space provided, the Demand Draft number and date, and a signed declaration. Attach self-attested copies of the certificates and testimonials, arranged in the same series as the list under Enclosures. Attach the Demand Draft of Rs.826 where the fee applies. Write 'Application for the post of ------' on the envelope. Send it to the address above on or before 28 November 2026. The notice does not state the postal mode or whether late receipt is rejected. It says only "on or before 28/11/2026".

rows.post: SAP FICO – Financial Accounting and Controlling

content_sections.heading: MOIL Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists a scope of responsibilities for each module, as follows. Act as the functional representative for SAP HCM from MOIL's side. Study and document existing HCM processes and facilitate As-Is and To-Be process mapping for S/4HANA with RISE. Coordinate with the HR/Personnel Functional Department, SAP, SAP S/4HANA Consultancy and the SI. Review and validate HCM configuration, functional specifications and proposed solutions submitted by the SI. Coordinate employee master data, organisational structure, payroll-related and other relevant data migration activities. Participate in integration testing, UAT, defect resolution and business-process validation. Coordinate user training, preparation/review of user manuals and knowledge-transfer activities. Support cutover, Go-Live and post-Go-Live stabilization. Monitor HCM-related issues, action points and deliverables and provide regular updates to concerned stakeholders. Act as the functional representative for SAP FICO from MOIL's side. Analyse existing Finance and Controlling processes and facilitate As-Is and To-Be process mapping. Coordinate with the Finance Functional Department, SAP, SAP S/4HANA Consultancy and the SI. Review and validate FICO configuration, functional specifications and proposed solutions. Coordinate financial data migration, data validation and financial reconciliation activities. Ensure appropriate integration of FICO with MM, SD, PM, PP and HCM. Provide functional support for relevant Funds Management (FM) and Treasury and Risk Management (TRM) processes, wherever applicable. Participate in testing, UAT, defect resolution and business-process validation. Coordinate user training, cutover, Go-Live and post-Go-Live stabilization. Monitor FICO-related issues and ensure timely resolution in coordination with the SI and other stakeholders. Act as the functional representative for SAP MM from MOIL's side. Analyse procurement, purchasing, inventory, stores and material-management processes. Coordinate with the Materials/Procurement & Stores Functional Department, SAP, SAP S/4HANA Consultancy and the SI. Facilitate As-Is and To-Be process mapping and review proposed S/4HANA solutions. Review material master, vendor master and related data migration activities. Validate MM configuration, functional specifications, workflows and integration requirements. Coordinate integration with FICO, PM, PP and other relevant modules. Participate in testing, UAT, defect resolution and data validation. Support user training, documentation, cutover and Go-Live activities. Provide post-Go-Live support and coordinate resolution of MM-related issues. Act as the functional representative for SAP PM from MOIL's side. Analyse existing mining, plant and equipment maintenance processes and facilitate As-Is and To-Be process mapping. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in MOIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are six (06) vacancies: one UR post each in SAP HCM, SAP FICO, SAP MM, SAP PM, SAP SD and SAP PP. The notice calls them tentative.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for MOIL SAP Functional Consultant posts?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent on or before 28 November 2026 to the General Manager (Mines) & Additional Charge HoD (Pers.), MOIL Ltd, Nagpur.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for MOIL SAP Functional Consultant?
faq.answer: BE/B.Tech/Any Graduate for all six posts, with minimum 5 years of relevant SAP S/4HANA with RISE functional experience in the respective module. A minimum CTC of 8 Lakhs per annum from the current/past employer is also required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for MOIL FTE recruitment?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 40 years as on 28/11/2026 for General category candidates. Relaxation is as per Government guidelines, and maximum age including all relaxation cannot exceed 53 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for MOIL SAP Functional Consultants?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay is ₹1,33,490 per month for each post. Employer's PF contribution, HRA (if Company accommodation not provided), gratuity and other applicable benefits come under the FTE Policy of MOIL.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for MOIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: General (UR), EWS and OBC (Creamy and Non-Creamy Layer) candidates pay Rs.826 including GST by non-refundable Demand Draft. SC/ST/PwBD/EXS/Employees of MOIL are exempted.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for MOIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in Annexure A, attach self-attested copies of the listed documents and the Demand Draft where applicable, write 'Application for the post of ------' on the envelope and send it to MOIL Bhavan, 1-A, Katol Road, Nagpur-440 013.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected by MOIL?
faq.answer: MOIL may hold a written/skill assessment, wherever considered necessary, followed by an interview/technical evaluation. The Company decides the mode of selection depending on the number of applications.

faq.question: Q9. Is the MOIL SAP Consultant job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is Fixed-Term Employment, with an initial tenure of up to three years. It may be extended up to two years, not exceeding twelve months at a time.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one SAP module?
faq.answer: The notice does not allow or bar this. It asks for the post name to be written on the envelope as 'Application for the post of ------'.
